extension.summary: Download your premiumize.me cloud files at full speed and play them locally
extension.description: Browse your premiumize.me cloud, download videos over several parallel connections, start watching while they download, and play them from local or USB storage. Downloads resume after restarts, and subtitles next to a video come along with it.
extension.disclaimer: Needs a premiumize.me account. Not made by or affiliated with premiumize.me.
extension.news: 1.0.1: Selecting a cloud video now shows the Play now / Download only / Stream choice as a normal list before playback starts (it could be invisible before). Corrected the Shield permission path in messages. 1.0.0: first release
